contexts.text: Tabrets and pipes () = the affections (of good and truth), and the joys of these [affections].
The various instruments of sound; as pipes, flutes, etc., sound from a like blowing... according to their forms.
The sound of their speech is like that of a bird-catcher's pipe.
The pipe,etc.(), in the opposite sense, here = exultations and gloryings from the falsities of evil.
